## 1bc09b475319

**Reproduced accepted-domain shortcut and contract defects; audit target left unchanged.** Current generator SHA-256 is `3d9835756a2a0d9d692df242abd2cff7aa5928eacb08e008829faeb1c1ac2445`; executed rule hash is `187795461399`.

The rival program paints color 8 into every zero cell immediately left or right of any color-6 cell. The authority instead requires the intended horizontal bar structure. This rival fits all 3 canonical pairs and all 60 ordinary generated draws sampled at seed `20261007`, sample indices `0` through `19`, in easy/medium/hard. The advertised override `texture="length_one_bars"` creates three singleton 6 cells; the authority leaves the grid unchanged, while the rival adds six color-8 caps.

The singleton input passes `self_check` both with and without metadata and is produced by the generator’s own advertised override, so this is an accepted-domain witness rather than an out-of-domain thought experiment. Exact input, Racket output, rival output, six differing cells, source identity, and aggregate fit counts are retained in `checks/audit/1bc09b475319/`.

The target battery failed with 7 green, 2 advisory, and 3 failed stages. Lint, defect lint, and override failed; the override report includes missing/inert controls, difficulty-narrowed values, 1,800 generation errors, 4,590 mismatches, and accepted unknown keys. Evidence: `checks/audit/1bc09b475319-battery/checks/1bc09b475319_before_battery_summary.json`.

Supported authority replay command: `python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 1bc09b475319 --input ../checks/audit/1bc09b475319/input.json --out ../checks/audit/1bc09b475319/racket.json` from `packet_root/repo`.

## 1bc09b475319

**Finding A1 — reproduced distribution shortcut; no measured ambiguous default-domain query.** The normal generator never emits a horizontal singleton of color 6. Consequently, the rival “paint every zero cell with an immediately adjacent horizontal 6 as cyan” agrees with the intended “require at least two consecutive 6s” rule throughout the normal domain. It also fits all three canonical pairs. The generator comment claiming that ordinary demonstrations refute “cap every cell next to color 6” is too broad: ordinary demonstrations can refute vertical expansion, but cannot refute the horizontal-only rival measured here.

A distinguishing input is genuinely generated by the advertised degenerate texture `length_one_bars`, using seed `audit-1bc09b475319-horizontal-single-neighbor`, sample index 0, difficulty `medium`, overrides `{"texture":"length_one_bars"}`. The 9×11 input has isolated 6s at (1,3), (3,7), and (5,2), using zero-based coordinates. The actual Racket output is the unchanged input; the rival adds six 8s at (1,2), (1,4), (3,6), (3,8), (5,1), and (5,3). This input passes `self_check` both with the declared texture metadata and without metadata. It belongs to the documented explicit-degenerate generator domain, and does not occur in ordinary generation, which chooses bar lengths 2–5.

**Bounded measurements.** The retained public `apply` invocation checked 64 unique grids: 20 ordinary generated inputs in each of `easy`, `medium`, and `hard` (same seed, sample indexes 0–19, no overrides), the one singleton degenerate, and all three canonical pairs. The rival agreed with actual Racket on 60/60 ordinary draws and 3/3 canonical pairs, and disagreed on the singleton degenerate. All 64 passed the target validator. There is no claimed lesson-census result and no measured differing query assembled from default-domain examples: the two rules are extensionally equal on that restricted domain. The demonstrated risk is that default training does not teach the minimum-length condition needed for a supported degenerate input. This audit does not establish how often downstream consumers deliberately request degenerate textures.

**Source identity.** Generator SHA-256: `3d9835756a2a0d9d692df242abd2cff7aa5928eacb08e008829faeb1c1ac2445` (the immutable audit draw). Executed/catalog rule hash: `187795461399`, with matching authority. Exact executed rule-text SHA-256: `4cd72a2b5260aa266235397c4604b216a98d3b6e0eea618a3daff9f24d9c9b39`. No repository source was changed.

**Evidence and reproduction.** `checks/audit/1bc09b475319/witness.json` contains the generated input, actual reference output, rival output, differing coordinates, seed/index/overrides, validator results, source hashes and exact reference command. `cases.json` retains all 64 case identities and grids; `input.json` is the supported public input batch; `racket.json` is the actual public reference receipt; `summary.json` contains measured counts; `probe.py` implements the rival and replay; `commands.json` records actual commands, working directories, zero exit statuses and retained evidence paths. Run prepare and compare from `packet_root`; run the reference command from `packet_root` (its payload executes in `repo`). The public `apply` command refuses to overwrite an existing output, so replay into a fresh evidence directory or retain/rename the existing receipt before repeating it.

**Possible follow-up, outside this findings-only audit.** If generated lessons are expected to generalize to the advertised singleton texture, teach a singleton exclusion alongside a real bar, or deliberately include the singleton degenerate as a demonstration. If the intended training domain is only ordinary bars, document the restricted domain and treat this as an equivalent shortcut within that domain rather than an incorrect ordinary output.
